spec.description: Golden Hour Planner: plan photography trips around golden/blue hour timing, create shot planning cards with lighting/lens/subject details, track shooting streaks and weekly progress, access camera settings cheat sheets and composition guides, and run One Lens Challenge sessions.

tools.label: Plan Trip
tools.description: Calculate golden hour, blue hour, sunrise, and sunset windows for a travel destination across your trip dates. Shows a daily shooting schedule with pre-dawn scout time, morning/evening golden hours, blue hours, and midday rest periods. Use when the user says: 'plan golden hour trip', 'golden hour schedule for my trip', 'photography trip planner'.

locations.description: Comma-separated list of key locations to photograph

tools.label: Shot Planning Cards
tools.description: Create and manage shot planning cards for your trip. Each card tracks location, best time of day, focal length, subject type, light direction, and completion status (scouted/attempted/got the shot). Use when the user says: 'plan my shots', 'add shot card', 'shot planning', 'manage shot list'.

action.description: Action: load, add, update, delete, toggle_scouted, toggle_attempted, toggle_got_it

city.description: Destination city for this shot plan

bestTime.description: Best time: morning_golden, evening_golden, blue_hour, midday_ok

subjectType.description: Subject: architecture, portrait, street, landscape, culture

lightDirection.description: Light direction: front_lit, side_lit, back_lit, silhouette

tools.label: Weekly Review
tools.description: Weekly review dashboard showing shots planned vs attempted vs completed, golden hour session streak, and motivational tips from elite photographers. Use when the user says: 'weekly review', 'shooting stats', 'how am I doing', 'golden hour streak'.

city.description: City to review (uses current trip if omitted)

sessionDate.description: Date of golden hour session (YYYY-MM-DD) for log_session action

tools.label: Quick Reference
tools.description: Camera settings cheat sheet for golden hour photography, composition reminders (rule of thirds, leading lines, frame within frame, light as subject), and gear checklist. Use when the user says: 'camera settings', 'cheat sheet', 'composition tips', 'golden hour settings'.

tools.label: One Lens Challenge
tools.description: Track your One Lens Challenge — commit to shooting with only one focal length for an entire day or trip. Log daily entries, track your streak, and review what you learned. Use when the user says: 'one lens challenge', 'lens challenge', 'single lens day', 'track my lens challenge'.

shotCount.description: Number of shots taken that day

bestShot.description: Description of your best shot of the day

lesson.description: What you learned shooting with this one lens
